dag_infos.description: New Taipei City deaths by single year of the deceased's age and sex, from MOI Household Registration open data ODRP031. The age columns are single-year ages, so the 18-35 youth range is exact and needs no apportionment.

data_infos.name_cn: 新北市死亡人數（按死亡者單齡年齡、性別、行政區）
data_infos.source_type: 內政部戶政司 RIS OpenData API (ODRP031)
data_infos.dataset_description: 內政部戶政司 ODRP031「人口死亡數按死亡者性別、單一年齡分」年度資料。本DAG只取新北市所轄行政區（年度若有來源缺漏則保留實況），將寬表的0至99歲及100歲以上男女欄位轉為長表。來源的0歲本年／去年出生欄是0歲的細分項，故不重複納入；總計欄只用來做分齡加總對帳。死亡者年齡是單一年齡，因此18至35歲可exact取得、不需分攤。實測涵蓋民國106至114年（西元2017至2025年）。
data_infos.etl_description: Fetch ODRP031 one ROC year at a time with a browser User-Agent and COUNTY=新北市, page through responseData until totalPage, and discover years in both directions from ROC 114, stopping only after two consecutive OD-0102-S no-data responses. If the county-filtered request returns OD-0102-S, retry that same year without COUNTY before declaring no data, because ROC 113 has Chinese columns and its county filter returns the no-data code despite nationwide data existing. RIS no-data is HTTP 200 with responseCode OD-0102-S, so responseCode—not HTTP status—is authoritative. Strip BOMs and normalise the English/Chinese field aliases because the schema varies by year. Discover age columns by anchored role patterns, exclude the 0-year this-year/last-year subcolumns, and raise on missing or unexpected ages. Melt every single-age male/female column into one fact row. Reconcile the age-column sums to the source death_m/death_f/death_total for every district and year before loading.
